title: Rav Acha son of Rav Ashi
author: Aharon Hyman
attribution: Model-assisted translation, editorially reviewed; publication authorized by Joshua Waxman.

paragraphs: He is mentioned in Zevachim 91a, raising a difficulty against Ravina; Hyman proposes the reading Rav Acha son of Rava, as in Dikdukei Soferim. In Chullin 97b, where Rav Acha son of Rav Ashi disagrees with Ravina, he proposes the reading there as “bar Rav,” according to the reading of the She’iltot, Vayishlach; Dikdukei Soferim likewise reports corruption in the Venice printing. Hyman identifies the Ravina who disagrees with him as the later Ravina.

notes.text: The saved Davidson Zevachim 91a retains Rav Acha son of Rav Ashi. Hyman’s Rava/bar Rav emendations, Venice-printing account and identification of the later Ravina remain his claims; digital text is not printed-pixel or correction-history proof.

The consulted Chullin 97b has Acha bar Rav Ashi in one exchange and Acha bar Rav in another. Those separate occurrences do not verify Hyman’s She’iltot, Venice-printing or later-Ravina identifications.
